name: Erissery (Pumpkin and Lentil Stew)
instructions: 1. Pressure cook the soaked cowpeas until soft and set aside.
2. In a pot, cook the pumpkin cubes with turmeric, chili powder, salt, and enough water until tender.
3. Grind the grated coconut, cumin seeds, and green chilies into a smooth paste. Add this paste to the cooked pumpkin and simmer for 3 minutes.
4. Add the cooked cowpeas to the mixture and stir well until combined.
5. In a small pan, heat coconut oil and splutter mustard seeds. Add dried red chilies, curry leaves, and the remaining grated coconut. Sauté until the coconut turns golden brown.
6. Pour this tempering over the Erissery, mix gently, and serve hot with steamed rice.
description: Erissery is a quintessential Keralite dish, often served as a part of the traditional 'Sadya' feast. It represents the balanced use of vegetables and legumes, highlighting the state's love for coconut-based preparations.
